docs.title: pydd
docs.text:
Dump and die for Python web apps. HTML dumps in the browser during HTTP requests; terminal output everywhere else.

Built on pydump — the terminal dump-and-die core.

Interactive HTML dump — FastAPI / Flask / Django

docs.text:

docs.title: Quick example
docs.text:
import pydd  # installs dd/dump as builtins + FastAPI patch

@app.get("/posts/{post_id}")
def show_post(post_id: int):
    post = load_post(post_id)
    dd(post)   # HTML 500 in browser — no from-import needed

Explicit import still works: from pydd import dd, dump, render_html, render_text.

docs.title: Live preview
docs.text: Multiple vars — labeled panels in the browser Typed header, expandable tree, call-site tip Outside HTTP — same data via pydump in the terminal

docs.title: What pydd does
docs.text: Context Behavior Inside an HTTP request Interactive HTML dump → HTTP 500 response CLI / script / test Terminal dump via pydump → SystemExit(1) dd(fastapi_app) at boot Arm HTML on every request; server stays running

docs.title: Public functions
docs.text: Function Description dd(*args, **kwargs) Dump and stop — HTML 500 in request, boot arm, or terminal exit dump(*args, **kwargs) Dump to stderr without stopping (in requests: stderr only) render_html(*args, **kwargs) Return HTML string without raising render_text(*args, **kwargs) Return terminal string via pydump configure(project_root=...) Set base path for // file:line tips install_helpers() Inject web-aware dd/dump into builtins

docs.title: Public types
docs.text: Symbol Description DdException Raised in-request; carries .html for framework handlers DumpNode Tree node from pydump inspection (re-export) inspect_value(value) Walk value → DumpNode (re-export from pydump) pydump Module re-export for terminal-only use

docs.title: Integration helpers
docs.text:
from pydd.integrations import (
    install_fastapi,
    install_flask,
    install_django,
    PyddMiddleware,
    patch_fastapi,
)
Function Use install_fastapi(app) Register middleware + handler on one FastAPI app install_flask(app) Register Flask hooks install_django() No-op reminder — use middleware in settings PyddMiddleware Django middleware class patch_fastapi() Patch FastAPI.__init__ globally (called on import pydd)

docs.title: dd() decision tree
docs.text:
dd(*args, **kwargs)
  │
  ├─ build HTML page
  │
  ├─ in HTTP request?  → raise DdException(page)  → framework returns 500 HTML
  │
  ├─ FastAPI app in args/kwargs?  → arm boot HTML on app, return
  │
  └─ else  → print terminal dump, SystemExit(1)

docs.title: Multiple values
docs.text:
dd(user, post, filters=query_params)

Each positional and keyword argument produces a separate dump block.

docs.title: Configure tips
docs.text:
from pathlib import Path
from pydd import configure

configure(project_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent)

Tips show paths relative to project_root, e.g. // app/views.py:42.

docs.title: Editor and linter
docs.text: Runtime builtin injection works at runtime but static analyzers need help.

docs.title: Ruff
docs.text:
[tool.ruff]
builtins = ["dd", "dump"]

docs.title: Pyright / Pylance / basedpyright
docs.text:
Prefer explicit import:

from pydd import dd, dump

Or type-checking only:

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pydd import dd, dump

dd(user)  # runtime uses builtin if pydd was imported elsewhere

docs.title: PyCharm
docs.text:
Inspections → Python → Unresolved references → ignored identifiers: dd, dump

Warning

Do not ship a full typings/builtins.pyi — it can replace typeshed and break project typing.

docs.title: Demo
docs.text: Copy-paste examples you can run locally. All demos return HTTP 500 when dd() fires — that is expected.

docs.title: Sample output (HTML)
docs.text:
When you visit a debug route in the browser:

dict:4 [▼ // views.py:18
  "id" => 1
  "author" => "Jane Doe"
  "title" => "Hello world"
  "tags" => list:3 [▶]
]

Click list:3 [▶] or the header to expand nested data.

docs.title: Sample output (terminal)
docs.text:
Same data outside a request:

dict:4 [
  "id" => 1
  "author" => "Jane Doe"
  "title" => "Hello world"
  "tags" => list:3 [
    0 => "python"
    1 => "debug"
    2 => "pydd"
  ]
] // script.py:10

docs.title: FastAPI demo
docs.text:
main.py:

from pathlib import Path
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydd import configure, dd

configure(project_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent)

app = FastAPI()

SAMPLE = {
    "id": 1,
    "author": "Jane Doe",
    "title": "Hello world",
    "tags": ["python", "debug", "pydd"],
}

@app.get("/")
def root():
    return {"message": "Visit /demo to trigger dd()"}

@app.get("/demo")
def demo():
    dd(SAMPLE)

pip install "pydd-web[fastapi]"
uvicorn main:app --reload
# open http://127.0.0.1:8000/demo

docs.title: Flask demo
docs.text:
app.py:

from pathlib import Path
from flask import Flask, request
from pydd import configure, dd
from pydd.integrations import install_flask

configure(project_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent)

app = Flask(__name__)
install_flask(app)

@app.get("/demo")
def demo():
    dd({
        "title": "Flask demo",
        "query": dict(request.args),
        "sample": {"id": 1, "tags": ["flask", "pydd"]},
    })

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(port=5000, debug=True)

pip install "pydd-web[flask]"
python app.py
# open http://127.0.0.1:5000/demo?foo=bar

docs.title: Django demo
docs.text:
Minimal debug view:

# myapp/views.py
from pydd import dd

def demo(request):
    dd({
        "title": "Django demo",
        "GET": dict(request.GET),
        "method": request.method,
    })

Add URL + middleware per Django guide.

docs.text:
No web server — uses pydump fallback:

import pydd

data = {"framework": None, "mode": "terminal"}
dd(data)  # prints to stderr, exits 1

Or use pydump directly: pydump demo.

docs.title: Core capabilities
docs.text:
• Two modes, one API — HTML dumps inside HTTP requests; terminal dumps everywhere else
  • Laravel-style helpers — import pydd once, then use dd / dump as builtins project-wide
  • Interactive HTML — dark Symfony-style theme with expand/collapse on nested structures
  • Shared inspection core — same DumpNode tree as pydump
  • Call-site tips — $variable · kind · type and // file:line in HTML and terminal
  • Multiple values — pass positional and keyword arguments; each gets its own dump block
  • Zero-config FastAPI — middleware and exception handler installed on import pydd
  • Explicit Flask / Django hooks — install_flask(app) and PyddMiddleware
  • Boot mode (FastAPI) — dd(app) arms HTML on every request while the server keeps running
  • Includes pydump — terminal debugging without a second dependency declaration

docs.title: Behavior matrix
docs.text: Call In HTTP request CLI / script dd(app) boot dd(x) HTML 500 stderr + exit 1 arm HTML (refresh tab) dump(x) stderr only stderr only stderr only render_html(x) return string return string return string render_text(x) return string return string return string

docs.title: FastAPI
docs.text:
• Auto-patches FastAPI.__init__ to register middleware and DdException handler
  • Request-scoped flag via ContextVar (async-safe)
  • Boot mode serves armed HTML before any route runs
  • Manual alternative: install_fastapi(app) without import side effects

docs.title: Flask
docs.text:
• before_request / teardown_request for request detection
  • Error handler returns (html, 500) for DdException
  • No boot mode yet

docs.title: Django
docs.text:
• PyddMiddleware sets request context in __call__
  • Catches DdException and returns HttpResponse(status=500)
  • Requires explicit middleware entry in settings.py

docs.title: HTML dump features
docs.text:
• Collapsible nested containers (click ▶ / header to expand)
  • Separate <pre class="sf-dump"> blocks for multiple values
  • Tips on header line when collapsed: [▶] // file:line
  • Tips after [▼ when expanded
  • Default collapse depth: max_depth=1 in browser (terminal fully expands)

docs.title: Terminal fallback
docs.text:
When not in an HTTP request and no FastAPI app is passed to dd():

  • Delegates to pydump ANSI formatter on stderr
  • Skips pydd internal frames in call-site tips
  • dd() raises SystemExit(1) after printing

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
• configure(project_root=Path(...)) — relative paths in // tips
  • Boot URL hints from HOST, PORT, UVICORN_HOST, UVICORN_PORT env vars

docs.title: What pydd is not
docs.text:
Development only

  • Not for production — stops the request with HTTP 500
  • Boot mode hijacks all routes until restart
  • No HTML collapse in terminal — use render_text for full CLI trees
  • Limited object introspection — same rules as pydump (public attrs only)

docs.title: Getting started
docs.text: This guide gets you from zero to an HTML dump in a FastAPI app in under five minutes.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Python 3.10+
  • A web framework (FastAPI, Flask, or Django)

docs.title: 1. Install
docs.text:
pip install pydd-web

For FastAPI with all server extras:

pip install "pydd-web[fastapi]"

See the full Installation guide for pip, uv, and framework extras.

docs.title: 2. Minimal FastAPI app
docs.text:
Create main.py:

from pathlib import Path
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydd import configure, dd

configure(project_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent)

app = FastAPI()

@app.get("/debug")
def debug_route():
    user = {"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "roles": ["admin", "editor"]}
    dd(user)

docs.title: 3. Run the server
docs.text: uvicorn main:app --reload

docs.title: 4. Trigger the dump
docs.text:
Open http://127.0.0.1:8000/debug in your browser.

You should see:

  • HTTP status 500 (expected — dd() stops the request)
  • A dark-theme interactive dump with expand/collapse on nested data
  • A tip line like // main.py:14 · user · container · dict

docs.title: 5. Use Laravel-style globals (optional)
docs.text:
Instead of from pydd import dd, you can rely on builtins:

import pydd  # once, e.g. in main.py

# in any other module — no import needed
dd(some_value)

Editor / linter

Ruff and type checkers do not see injected builtins. Add [tool.ruff] builtins = ["dd", "dump"] or use explicit imports. See API Reference — Editor setup.

docs.title: Django
docs.text: Django uses PyddMiddleware in your MIDDLEWARE setting. Boot mode is not available yet.

docs.title: Install and run
docs.text:
pip install "pydd-web[django]"
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py runserver

docs.title: Settings
docs.text:
# config/settings.py
from pathlib import Path
from pydd import configure

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
configure(project_root=BASE_DIR)

MIDDLEWARE = [
    "django.middleware.security.SecurityMiddleware",
    # ... your other middleware ...
    "pydd.integrations.django.PyddMiddleware",
]

Place PyddMiddleware near the end of the stack (after session/auth if you want request context populated).

docs.title: Views
docs.text:
# debugapp/views.py
from django.http import HttpResponse
from pydd import dd

def home(request):
    return HttpResponse('<a href="/dd/">/dd/</a>')

def debug_dump(request):
    dd({
        "title": "Django dd test",
        "query": dict(request.GET),
        "user": str(request.user),
    })

docs.title: URLs
docs.text:
# debugapp/urls.py
from django.urls import path
from . import views

urlpatterns = [
    path("", views.home),
    path("dd/", views.debug_dump),
]

Visit /dd/ to trigger the HTML dump.

docs.title: What the middleware does
docs.text:
PyddMiddleware.__call__:

  1. Sets the in-request flag
  2. Calls get_response(request)
  3. Catches DdException → HttpResponse(html, status=500)
  4. Resets the flag in finally

process_exception is kept for compatibility with older Django patterns.

docs.text:
# settings.py or wsgi.py
import pydd

# in any view
dd(request.session)

docs.text: FastAPI is auto-wired when you import pydd. No manual install() call needed.

pipuv

docs.title: Basic route dump
docs.text:
from pathlib import Path
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydd import configure, dd

configure(project_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent)

app = FastAPI()

@app.get("/posts/{post_id}")
def show_post(post_id: int):
    post = load_post(post_id)
    dd(post)   # HTML 500 in browser

Importing pydd patches FastAPI.__init__ to register:

  1. HTTP middleware — sets the in-request flag; serves boot HTML if armed
  2. Exception handler — converts DdException to HTMLResponse(status=500)

docs.title: Boot dump
docs.text:
Arm a dump at startup while keeping the server alive:

app = FastAPI()
dd(app)   # every request serves dump HTML until restart

Warning

While boot mode is armed, every URL returns the same dump. Remove dd(app) and restart when done.

The console prints something like:

[pydd] Dump armed → http://127.0.0.1:8000/

Refresh your browser tab — no auto-open.

Host/port come from HOST/PORT or UVICORN_HOST/UVICORN_PORT (default 127.0.0.1:8000).

docs.title: Verify with curl
docs.text:
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:8000/posts/1
# 500 when dd() runs in route

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import pydd
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get("/debug")
assert response.status_code == 500
assert "sf-dump" in response.text

docs.title: Avoid auto-patch (advanced)
docs.text:
If you need zero import side effects:

# Do NOT import pydd at module level
from pydd.integrations import install_fastapi

app = FastAPI()
install_fastapi(app)

You lose automatic patching for other FastAPI() instances in the same process.

docs.title: Full example
docs.text:
from pathlib import Path
from flask import Flask, request
from pydd import configure, dd
from pydd.integrations import install_flask

configure(project_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent)

app = Flask(__name__)
install_flask(app)

@app.get("/dd")
def debug_dump():
    dd({
        "title": "Flask dd test",
        "query": dict(request.args),
    })

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(debug=True)

Visit http://127.0.0.1:5000/dd to see the HTML dump.

docs.title: What install_flask does
docs.text:
Hook Purpose before_request Sets in_request flag via ContextVar teardown_request Resets the flag after each request @app.errorhandler(DdException) Returns (html, 500)

Installation is idempotent — safe to call once at app creation.

docs.title: مثال سریع
docs.text:
import pydd  # dd/dump به builtins + patch خودکار FastAPI

@app.get("/posts/{post_id}")
def show_post(post_id: int):
    post = load_post(post_id)
    dd(post)   # HTML با کد 500 در مرورگر — بدون from-import

docs.title: pydump در مقابل pydd
docs.text: نیاز بسته نام PyPI اسکریپت، CLI، تست pydump pydump-dd FastAPI / Flask / Django pydd (این بسته) pydd-web هر دو فقط pydd نصب کنید pydump-dd هم نصب می‌شود

docs.title: توابع عمومی
docs.text: تابع توضیح dd(*args, **kwargs) دامپ و توقف — HTML 500 در درخواست، boot، یا خروج ترمینال dump(*args, **kwargs) دامپ روی stderr بدون توقف (در درخواست: فقط stderr) render_html(*args, **kwargs) رشته HTML بدون raise render_text(*args, **kwargs) رشته ترمینال via pydump configure(project_root=...) مسیر پایه برای tipهای // file:line install_helpers() تزریق dd/dump آگاه از وب به builtins

docs.title: انواع عمومی
docs.text: نماد توضیح DdException در درخواست raise؛ .html برای handler فریم‌ورک DumpNode گره درخت inspection pydump (re-export) inspect_value(value) value → DumpNode (re-export) pydump re-export ماژول pydump

docs.title: helperهای integration
docs.text:
from pydd.integrations import (
    install_fastapi,
    install_flask,
    install_django,
    PyddMiddleware,
    patch_fastapi,
)
تابع کاربرد install_fastapi(app) middleware + handler روی یک app FastAPI install_flask(app) hookهای Flask install_django() no-op — middleware در settings PyddMiddleware کلاس middleware Django patch_fastapi() patch سراسری FastAPI.__init__ (با import pydd)

docs.title: درخت تصمیم dd()
docs.text:
dd(*args, **kwargs)
  │
  ├─ ساخت صفحه HTML
  │
  ├─ در HTTP؟  → raise DdException(page)  → فریم‌ورک 500 HTML
  │
  ├─ app FastAPI در args/kwargs?  → arm boot HTML، return
  │
  └─ else  → چاپ ترمینال، SystemExit(1)

dd(user, post, filters=query_params)

هر آرگومان positional و keyword بلوک دامپ جدا دارد.

docs.text: مثال‌های copy-paste برای اجرای محلی. همه با dd() HTTP 500 می‌دهند — عادی است.

docs.title: نمونه خروجی (HTML)
docs.text:
باز کردن route دیباگ در مرورگر:

dict:4 [▼ // views.py:18
  "id" => 1
  "author" => "Jane Doe"
  "title" => "Hello world"
  "tags" => list:3 [▶]
]

روی list:3 [▶] یا header کلیک کنید.

docs.title: نمونه خروجی (ترمینال)

همان داده خارج از درخواست:

dict:4 [
  "id" => 1
  ...
  "tags" => list:3 [
    0 => "python"
    ...
  ]
] // script.py:10

docs.title: دمو FastAPI
docs.text:
main.py:

from pathlib import Path
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydd import configure, dd

configure(project_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent)

app = FastAPI()

SAMPLE = {
    "id": 1,
    "author": "Jane Doe",
    "title": "Hello world",
    "tags": ["python", "debug", "pydd"],
}

@app.get("/demo")
def demo():
    dd(SAMPLE)

pip install "pydd-web[fastapi]"
uvicorn main:app --reload
# http://127.0.0.1:8000/demo

docs.title: دمو Flask
docs.text:
app.py:

from pathlib import Path
from flask import Flask, request
from pydd import configure, dd
from pydd.integrations import install_flask

configure(project_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent)

app = Flask(__name__)
install_flask(app)

@app.get("/demo")
def demo():
    dd({
        "title": "Flask demo",
        "query": dict(request.args),
    })

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(port=5000, debug=True)

pip install "pydd-web[flask]"
python app.py

docs.title: قابلیت‌های اصلی
docs.text:
• دو حالت، یک API — دامپ HTML در درخواست HTTP؛ دامپ ترمینال در بقیه جاها
  • helperهای شبیه Laravel — یک‌بار import pydd، بعد dd / dump به‌صورت builtin در کل پروژه
  • HTML تعاملی — تم تیره شبیه Symfony با باز/بسته کردن ساختارهای تو در تو
  • هسته inspection مشترک — همان درخت DumpNode مثل pydump
  • tip محل فراخوانی — $variable · kind · type و // file:line در HTML و ترمینال
  • چند مقدار — آرگومان positional و keyword؛ هر کدام بلوک دامپ جدا
  • FastAPI بدون تنظیم — middleware و handler با import pydd
  • Flask / Django صریح — install_flask(app) و PyddMiddleware
  • Boot mode (FastAPI) — dd(app) HTML را روی هر درخواست آماده می‌کند؛ سرور زنده می‌ماند
  • شامل pydump — دیباگ ترمینال بدون وابستگی دوم

docs.title: جدول رفتار
docs.text: فراخوانی در HTTP CLI / اسکریپت boot با dd(app) dd(x) HTML 500 stderr + خروج 1 آماده HTML (refresh) dump(x) فقط stderr فقط stderr فقط stderr render_html(x) رشته رشته رشته render_text(x) رشته رشته رشته

docs.title: FastAPI
docs.text:
• patch خودکار FastAPI.__init__ برای middleware و handler مربوط به DdException
  • پرچم محدود به درخواست با ContextVar (سازگار با async)
  • Boot mode قبل از routeها HTML آماده‌شده را برمی‌گرداند
  • جایگزین دستی: install_fastapi(app) بدون side effect import

docs.title: Flask
docs.text:
• before_request / teardown_request برای تشخیص درخواست
  • error handler برای DdException با (html, 500)
  • هنوز boot mode ندارد

docs.title: Django
docs.text:
• PyddMiddleware context را در __call__ تنظیم می‌کند
  • DdException را می‌گیرد و HttpResponse(status=500) برمی‌گرداند
  • نیاز به middleware در settings.py

docs.title: امکانات دامپ HTML
docs.text:
• باز/بسته کردن containerهای تو در تو (کلیک روی ▶ یا header)
  • بلوک <pre class="sf-dump"> جدا برای چند مقدار
  • tip روی header وقتی بسته: [▶] // file:line
  • tip بعد از [▼ وقتی باز است
  • عمق پیش‌فرض بسته: max_depth=1 در مرورگر (ترمینال کامل باز می‌شود)

docs.title: fallback ترمینال
docs.text:
وقتی در HTTP نیستید و app FastAPI به dd() داده نشده:

  • فرمت ANSI pydump روی stderr
  • فریم‌های داخلی pydd در tip رد می‌شوند
  • dd() بعد از چاپ SystemExit(1) می‌دهد

docs.title: پیکربندی
docs.text:

  • URL boot از env: HOST, PORT, UVICORN_HOST, UVICORN_PORT

docs.title: pydd چه نیست
docs.text:
فقط برای توسعه

  • برای production نیست — درخواست را با 500 متوقف می‌کند
  • Boot mode همه routeها را می‌گیرد تا restart
  • در ترمینال collapse HTML نیست — برای درخت کامل render_text
  • introspection محدود — همان قوانین pydump (فقط attributeهای public)

Ruff و type checkerها builtins تزریق‌شده را نمی‌بینند. [tool.ruff] builtins = ["dd", "dump"] اضافه کنید یا import صریح. مرجع API — تنظیم ویرایشگر.

# config/settings.py
from pathlib import Path
from pydd import configure

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
configure(project_root=BASE_DIR)

MIDDLEWARE = [
    "django.middleware.security.SecurityMiddleware",
    # ... middlewareهای دیگر ...

]

PyddMiddleware را نزدیک انتهای لیست بگذارید.

docs.text:
# debugapp/views.py
from django.http import HttpResponse
from pydd import dd

def home(request):
    return HttpResponse('<a href="/dd/">/dd/</a>')

def debug_dump(request):
    dd({
        "title": "Django dd test",
        "query": dict(request.GET),
        "user": str(request.user),
    })

docs.title: middleware چه می‌کند
docs.text:
PyddMiddleware.__call__:

  1. پرچم in-request
  2. get_response(request)
  3. DdException → HttpResponse(html, status=500)
  4. reset در finally

process_exception برای سازگاری با الگوهای قدیمی Django مانده.

docs.title: FastAPI
docs.text: با import pydd، FastAPI خودکار وصل می‌شود. نیازی به install() دستی نیست.

docs.title: نصب و اجرا
docs.text:
pipuv 
pip install "pydd-web[fastapi]"
uvicorn main:app --reload

uv add "pydd-web[fastapi]"
uv run uvicorn main:app --reload

docs.title: دامپ در route
docs.text:
from pathlib import Path
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydd import configure, dd

configure(project_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent)

app = FastAPI()

@app.get("/posts/{post_id}")
def show_post(post_id: int):
    post = load_post(post_id)
    dd(post)   # HTML 500 در مرورگر

import pydd روی FastAPI.__init__ patch می‌زند:

  1. HTTP middleware — پرچم in-request؛ اگر boot آماده باشد HTML را برمی‌گرداند
  2. Exception handler — DdException → HTMLResponse(status=500)

docs.title: Boot dump
docs.text:
در startup دامپ آماده کنید؛ سرور زنده می‌ماند:

app = FastAPI()
dd(app)   # تا restart هر درخواست همان HTML را می‌دهد

Warning

در boot mode هر URL همان دامپ را برمی‌گرداند. وقتی تمام شد dd(app) را بردارید و restart کنید.

خروجی کنسول:

[pydd] Dump armed → http://127.0.0.1:8000/

تب مرورگر را refresh کنید — مرورگر خودکار باز نمی‌شود.

Host/port از HOST/PORT یا UVICORN_HOST/UVICORN_PORT (پیش‌فرض 127.0.0.1:8000).

docs.title: تأیید با curl
docs.text:
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:8000/posts/1
# 500 وقتی dd() در route اجرا شود

docs.title: بدون auto-patch (پیشرفته)
docs.text:
اگر side effect import نمی‌خواهید:

from pydd.integrations import install_fastapi

app = FastAPI()
install_fastapi(app)

patch خودکار برای instanceهای دیگر FastAPI() در همان process از بین می‌رود.

docs.title: مثال کامل
docs.text:
from pathlib import Path
from flask import Flask, request
from pydd import configure, dd
from pydd.integrations import install_flask

configure(project_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent)

app = Flask(__name__)
install_flask(app)

@app.get("/dd")
def debug_dump():
    dd({
        "title": "Flask dd test",
        "query": dict(request.args),
    })

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(debug=True)

http://127.0.0.1:5000/dd را باز کنید.
